title: [25/7/2024] The numbers of registered road vehicles in use
prompt: The chart below shows the numbers of registered road vehicles in use in a European country in 1996 and 2006. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the number of registered vehicles of different types in a European country in 1996 and 2006.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, private cars and other types were by far the most common type of vehicle in both years, with their numbers showing a substantial increase over the period. Meanwhile, the figures for other categories remained relatively stable at much lower levels.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two most numerous categories, private cars dominated the statistics with approximately 19 million vehicles with registration in 1996, around ten times as high as other types of vehicles' number. The figure for private cars then rose markedly to 24 million by 2006. Similarly, other types of vehicles saw a slight increase from about 1 million to 2 million over the same timeframe.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining categories, both lorries and motorcycles had similar figures of around 1 million vehicles in 1996, though lorries experienced a minor decline while motorcycles showed a slight decrease by 2006. Buses consistently recorded the lowest numbers, with less than 0.5 million vehicles in both years.
